update.title: OT-105.9: five passages on the poor as seen by another woven (#2160)
update.strand: open threads on completed clusters (#2160), OT-105.9 (M18)
update.researcher_instruction: "Weave the five OT-105.9 gaps as proposed (Jer 22:16-17, Job 31:16-17, Mar 14:4-7, Ecc 9:15-16, Est 9:22) with their claims, close OT-105.9, commit and push, then read OT-106.3 (M47)." (2026-10-18)
update.method: OT-105.9 (the ten P-coded M09 verses with an M18 word) read in their passages. Where M18 carries the act the verses were already told. Five passage gaps on OT-105's subject woven: Jer 22:13-17 (10.2, pointer 10.6), Ecc 9:15-16 (10.2), Job 31:16-17 and Est 9:22 (10.10 Friends, company and care), Mar 14:4-7 (10.13, with Matthew 26:8, 10). Rule 77: the only claim told in a touched passage (C-253, 10.6) is unaffected.
update.claims_changed_note: Five new claims, one per passage.

new.text: God names judging the cause of the poor and needy as knowing him, and sets it against eyes and heart given only to gain
new.beyond_text: reads Jer 22:16-17 as saying what knowing God is, in a deed for the poor

new.text: The poor wise man who saved the city was forgotten and his words not heard; what was seen in him was his poverty
new.beyond_text: reads 'though the poor man's wisdom is despised' as the reason he was forgotten and not heard

new.text: Job's oath counts refusing what the poor desired, and eating one's morsel alone, among the wrongs he disowns
new.beyond_text: reads the oath's conditions as acts he names as wrong

new.text: The gladness of deliverance is kept by giving, to one another and to the poor
new.beyond_text: sets the gifts to the poor as part of keeping the joy of Est 9:22

new.text: The indignation at the ointment, first said to themselves, named the poor as its reason, and Jesus put doing good to the poor in the hearers' own will

tellings.passage: God also says what knowing him is
The verses also give greed's reasons and its roots
Who speaks can decide whether a word is heard
Job's oath begins with what the poor wanted
Giving to the poor is also kept as part of joy
Whether what sets it off is true is part of the account
